```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(plotly)

theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
)

qc <- read_tsv(
  "../output/qc/sample_qc_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    rrna_mean_pct =
      (rrna_r1_pct + rrna_r2_pct) / 2,

    hbrna_mean_pct =
      (hbrna_r1_pct + hbrna_r2_pct) / 2
  )
```

# Introduction

Primary QC metrics for the CCHC RNA-seq samples are summarised below.

No samples are excluded at this stage.

# Data Summary

```{r data-summary}
tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Individuals",
    "Baseline samples",
    "Follow-up samples"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(qc),
    n_distinct(qc$individual),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "baseline"),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "follow-up")
  )
) |>
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

```{r group-summary}
qc |>
  count(
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    name = "Samples"
  ) |>
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

## Sample QC Table

```{r sample-qc-table}
sample_qc <- qc |>
  transmute(
    run,
    sample,
    individual,
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    mapping_rate = round(mapping_rate, 2),
    library_type,
    library_compatible_pct =
      round(library_compatible_pct, 2),
    decoy_pct =
      round(decoy_pct, 2),
    fragment_length_mean =
      round(fragment_length_mean, 2),
    fragment_length_sd =
      round(fragment_length_sd, 2),
    rrna_mean_pct =
      round(rrna_mean_pct, 2),
    hbrna_mean_pct =
      round(hbrna_mean_pct, 2)
  )

reactable(
  sample_qc,
  searchable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  resizable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    mapping_rate = colDef(
      name = "Mapping (%)"
    ),
    library_compatible_pct = colDef(
      name = "Compatible (%)"
    ),
    decoy_pct = colDef(
      name = "Decoy (%)"
    ),
    fragment_length_mean = colDef(
      name = "Fragment mean"
    ),
    fragment_length_sd = colDef(
      name = "Fragment SD"
    ),
    rrna_mean_pct = colDef(
      name = "rRNA (%)"
    ),
    hbrna_mean_pct = colDef(
      name = "HbRNA (%)"
    )
  )
)
```

## Salmon Library Type

```{r library-type}
qc |>
  count(
    library_type,
    name = "Samples"
  ) |>
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    bordered = TRUE
  )
```

# Salmon QC {.tabset}

## Mapping Rate

```{r mapping-rate}
p <- qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  mutate(
    sample_order = row_number(),
    hover = paste0(
      "Run: ", run,
      "<br>Individual: ", individual,
      "<br>Timepoint: ", timepoint,
      "<br>Mapping: ", round(mapping_rate, 2), "%"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      sample_order,
      mapping_rate,
      text = hover
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples ordered by mapping rate",
    y = "Salmon mapping rate (%)"
  )

ggplotly(
  p,
  tooltip = "text"
)
```

# QC Summary

```{r qc-summary}
qc_summary <- qc |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        mapping_rate,
        library_compatible_pct,
        decoy_pct,
        fragment_length_mean,
        fragment_length_sd,
        rrna_mean_pct,
        hbrna_mean_pct
      ),
      list(
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("metric", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(min|median|max)$"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(min, median, max),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    ),
    metric = metric |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  ) |>
  rename(
    Metric = metric,
    Minimum = min,
    Median = median,
    Maximum = max
  )

reactable(
  qc_summary,
  pagination = FALSE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```
